Who we are

Local builders, straight answers

SHIM Construction is based in Pudupattinam, working across the Thanjavur region. We keep crews small and supervision constant, so every project gets the same attention whether it's a home extension or a full commercial build.

  • ✓On-site supervision for the full duration of every project, not just the start.
  • ✓Written estimates before work begins — no surprise costs midway.
  • ✓Local material sourcing, so delays from outside suppliers don't stall your build.

Why SHIM

Built on the basics, done right

Quality materials, checked

Every material batch is checked on delivery, not assumed to be right off the invoice.

Site safety, non-negotiable

Helmets, barricading, and a safety briefing for every crew before work starts, every single day.

Timelines we hold to

A realistic schedule shared upfront, with weekly updates so you always know where things stand.

One point of contact

A single supervisor for your project from day one, so you're never chasing different people for updates.

Written estimates

Costs laid out before work begins, so there's no ambiguity about what's included.

Local, reachable

Based in Pudupattinam, Thanjavur — a call or a site visit is never far, before, during, or after the build.
